title: Framed tool composition

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Use familiar tools as a coherent composition because ordinary interface elements can carry identity when their visual relationships are deliberate.
strategic_value: A framed arrangement of editing tools and the mark can make Figma recognizable without a product screen.
demonstration: A framed print groups pen, pointer, pencil, eyedropper, hand and outlined Figma symbol inside a cyan selection box.
practical_value: Build a brand composition from product tools while keeping their silhouettes distinct.

content_islands.name: Tool arrangement
content_islands.spec: Pack large black-outlined tools and symbol across the light-gray portrait print.

content_islands.name: Selection frame
content_islands.spec: Place the cyan rectangular box and corner handles behind the objects.

content_islands.name: Physical frame
content_islands.spec: Retain the black frame and its wall shadow to show the print application.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph applies editing-tool shapes and selection handles to a framed print.
reference_purposes.Expression: Heavy black outlines and selective bright fills unify different tool silhouettes.
